run_MSLRDatasets_load: run the MSLRDatasets load method to parse MSLR-WEB30K text files into query-feature-relevance tensors
run_MSLRDatasets_save: run the MSLRDatasets save method to pickle loaded queries, features, and relevances to disk
run_train_all: run train_all to train DecisionTreeTrainer and LassoTrainer models on all, anchor URL, and body features
run_evaluate: run evaluate to benchmark OPE estimators like DM, IPS, DR, PseudoInverse, and PBM against NDCG or ERR metrics
run_main_cli: run the CLI with a JSON config file to load datasets and evaluate slate estimators across trainer and metric combinations
